title: 第382章 受伤第381章 魔窟大战
content_zh:
“好强……”龙佳颖红唇微白，气息急促，“他的修为底蕴，根本不是残魂该有的层次！”
并非二人太弱，而是这位魔宗老祖根基太过浑厚。
百年前可是元婴期高手，虽然伤势没有完全恢复，日日吸纳地底魔渊煞气，纵然身负旧患。
可全力爆发之下，依旧稳压金丹期修士一筹。
若是他伤势恢复，只需一念便可碾碎此地一切。
又是数道魔链狂轰而下！
接连几声巨响，双层结界彻底崩碎！
狂暴魔气顺势冲入，狠狠扫在二人身躯之上。
噗！
龙佳颖身形一晃，忍不住喷出一口清甜鲜血，踉跄后退数步，灵力瞬间紊乱枯竭，护体灵光黯淡到极致。
张昊宇硬扛大半攻势，胸口亦是一阵闷痛，喉间泛起腥甜。
他强行压下翻涌的气血，踏步挡在龙佳颖身前，眸光愈发冷峻。
他已然确认，以他和龙佳颖此刻的实力，正面硬拼，绝非这位老祖对手。
岩洞上空，魔雾人脸狞笑不止，杀意滔天：“本座百年旧伤未愈，本不想过早耗损魂力对付你们。
既然你们不识好歹，那便彻底留在这里，献祭神魂，成全本座恢复重伤！”
魔宗老祖猛地全力催动秘术，漫天魔气汇聚成一只遮天蔽日的漆黑魔掌，掌纹流淌血色凶光，带着覆灭一切的威势，缓缓压落！
掌风所过，空气冻结，灵力寂灭，整片岩洞的生机被彻底抽空。
张昊宇咬紧牙关，倾尽最后灵力凝聚剑光，刚想请小团团帮忙。
就在魔掌即将落下的生死刹那…
张昊宇感觉到空间，悄然泛起一抹极其细微、柔和的白光。

无人察觉、无人感应。
外界狂暴震天的魔气、浓烈霸道的魔威，尽数掩盖了这一缕微弱却极致纯净的本源灵气。
空间之内，软糯小小的团子身影悬浮半空。
小团团圆溜溜的大眼睛紧紧盯着外界危急场景，小爪子轻轻攥紧，满脸着急。
它一直安安静静待在空间里，全程看完了所有战斗，看到张昊宇被压制、被震伤，小家伙再也忍不住了。
不用张昊宇召唤，无需任何指令。
小团团微微嘟起小嘴，轻轻往前一吐。
一缕细若游丝、无色无味、无影无形的本源净化之光，悄无声息穿透空间壁垒，精准落在半空中魔宗老祖身上。
这光芒太淡、太隐秘，魔宗老祖根本没有任何察觉。
可下一瞬…
滋…！！
如同烈火烹冰雪、骄阳融黑雾！
魔宗老祖身体、最深层的魔魂本源，骤然传来一阵撕裂神魂、钻心刺骨的剧痛！
他百年未愈的旧伤，那道贯穿魂体、压制他百年无法恢复的本源裂痕，瞬间被这缕纯净本源硬生生撕开、激化！
“呃啊——！！”
前所未有的剧痛让这位隐忍百年的老魔发出一声凄厉至极的痛吼！
原本势不可挡、即将镇压二人的漆黑魔掌，力道瞬间崩泄、威势骤然消散！
漫天压制一切的魔气剧烈翻滚、紊乱溃散，原本凝实无比的残魂魔雾，瞬间出现大片大片的透明裂痕，魂体动荡不稳，濒临溃散！
没人知道发生了什么。
content_en:
"So strong..." Long Jiaying's red lips were slightly white and her breath was short, "His cultivation base is not at the level that a remnant soul should be!"
It's not that the two of them are too weak, but that the ancestor of the Demon Sect has too strong a foundation.
A hundred years ago, he was a master in the Nascent Soul stage. Although his injuries have not fully recovered, he is absorbing the evil energy of the underground demonic abyss every day, even though he is suffering from old problems.
But with all his strength, he was still able to hold down the Golden Core Stage cultivators.
If he recovers from his injuries, he can crush everything here with just one thought.
Several more magic chains crashed down!
There were several loud noises in succession, and the double-layered barrier completely collapsed!
The violent demonic energy rushed in and swept over the two bodies.
puff!
Long Jiaying's body swayed and she couldn't help but spurt out a mouthful of sweet blood. She staggered back a few steps. Her spiritual power was instantly disordered and exhausted, and her protective aura dimmed to the extreme.
Zhang Haoyu withstood most of the attack, feeling a dull pain in his chest and a sweet taste in his throat.
He forced down the surging energy and blood, stepped in front of Long Jiaying, his eyes became colder and colder.
He has already confirmed that with the current strength of him and Long Jiaying, they are no match for this ancestor in a head-on fight.
In the sky above the cave, the Demonic Fog Man's face was grinning ferociously, with overwhelming murderous intent: "I have a century-old injury that has not healed, and I didn't want to waste my soul power against you prematurely.
Since you don't know good from evil, then stay here completely, sacrifice your soul, and help me recover from serious injuries! "
The ancestor of the Demon Sect suddenly activated the secret technique with all his strength, and the demonic energy in the sky gathered into a dark palm that covered the sky and the sun. The palm prints flowed with a bloody and fierce light, and with the power of destroying everything, it slowly pressed down!
As the wind passed by, the air froze, the spiritual power was extinguished, and the entire cave was completely drained of life.
Zhang Haoyu gritted his teeth and used up the last of his spiritual energy to concentrate the sword light. He was just about to ask Xiao Tuantuan for help.
At the moment of life and death when the devil's clutches are about to fall...
Zhang Haoyu felt an extremely subtle and soft white light quietly glowing in the space.
No one notices, no one senses.
The violent and overwhelming demonic energy and the strong and overbearing demonic power in the outside world have completely covered up this weak but extremely pure source of spiritual energy.
Within the space, the figure of a soft and small dumpling was suspended in mid-air.
Xiao Tuan Tuan's big eyes stared closely at the critical scene outside, his little paws clenched slightly, and his face was full of worry.
It has been quietly staying in the space, watching all the battles, and seeing Zhang Haoyu being suppressed and injured, the little guy couldn't bear it anymore.
There is no need for Zhang Haoyu to summon him or any instructions.
The little ball pouted slightly and spat forward slightly.
A wisp of light as thin as a gossamer, colorless, odorless, and shadowless source of purification light quietly penetrated the space barrier and landed accurately on the Demon Sect Ancestor in mid-air.
This light was too faint and too secretive, so the Demon Sect ancestor didn't notice it at all.
But the next moment...
Zhi...! !
Like fire cooking ice and snow, and the scorching sun melting black mist!
The body of the ancestor of the demon sect and the deepest source of the demon soul suddenly felt a sharp pain that tore the soul and was bone-piercing!
His old wounds that had not healed for a hundred years, the original crack that penetrated his soul and suppressed his ability to recover for a hundred years, were instantly torn open and intensified by this pure source!
“Uhhh——!!”
The unprecedented pain caused this old demon who had endured for hundreds of years to let out a shrill roar of pain!
The dark devil's hand, which was originally unstoppable and was about to suppress the two of them, instantly collapsed and its power suddenly dissipated!
The demonic energy that suppressed everything in the sky rolled violently and collapsed in chaos. The originally extremely solid demonic mist of the residual soul suddenly appeared with large transparent cracks. The soul body was unstable and on the verge of collapse!
No one knows what happened.
